plain.li: {WISH}? We're short on everything and {OTHER_nameDef} wants {WISH}.
Before anyone runs off to build {WISH}, can we talk about the walls? The ones with holes in them?
I'm not saying no. I'm saying not before the things that keep us alive.
[poor] We can't afford it. We can barely afford rice.
[winter] Winter's here and we're talking about {WISH}. Priorities, people.
[afterraid] We nearly died yesterday, and the priority is {WISH}?
[trait:Ascetic] We don't need it. Nobody needs it. That's rather the point.
[trait:Ascetic] Every luxury is one more thing to lose when the raiders come.
[trait:Jealous] Funny how {OTHER_nameDef} always gets asked about first.
[trait:Industriousness] That's a lot of hours for something nobody needs. I'd rather spend them on work that matters.

warm.li: I don't want to be unkind, {OTHER_nameDef}. But others need help first.
Could it wait? Just until everyone has a bed and a meal?

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} wants {WISH}. I want a pony. Neither of us is getting one.
If {OTHER_nameDef} gets {WISH}, I want one too. That's how this works now, apparently.

cheerful.li: Fun idea! Terrible timing! Let's revisit it when we're not on fire!

gloomy.li: Sure, build {WISH}. It'll make a lovely ruin.
We'll spend everything on it and then the raiders will burn it. Same as always.

cold.li: The resources for {WISH} would be better spent elsewhere. I object.
{OTHER_nameDef}'s comfort is not a colony priority.
